transcript.zh: 提問：圖片裡有幾個學生？
transcript.py: Tíwèn: Túpiàn lǐ yǒu jǐ ge xuéshēng?
transcript.en: Question: How many students are in the picture?

transcript.zh: (A) 三個
transcript.py: (A) sān ge
transcript.en: (A) Three

transcript.zh: (B) 四個
transcript.py: (B) sì ge
transcript.en: (B) Four

transcript.zh: (C) 七個
transcript.py: (C) qī ge
transcript.en: (C) Seven

transcript.zh: 提問：這個人在做什麼運動？
transcript.py: Tíwèn: Zhè ge rén zài zuò shénme yùndòng?
transcript.en: Question: What sport is this person playing?

transcript.zh: (A) 他在打籃球
transcript.py: (A) tā zài dǎlánqiú
transcript.en: (A) He is playing basketball.

transcript.zh: (B) 他在打網球
transcript.py: (B) tā zài dǎwǎngqiú
transcript.en: (B) He is playing tennis.

transcript.zh: (C) 他在打棒球
transcript.py: (C) tā zài dǎ bàngqiú
transcript.en: (C) He is playing baseball.

transcript.zh: 提問：請問小美喜歡做什麼？
transcript.py: Tíwèn: Qǐngwèn Xiǎoměi xǐhuān zuò shénme?
transcript.en: Question: What does Xiaomei like to do?

transcript.zh: (A) 她喜歡打掃
transcript.py: (A) tā xǐhuān dǎsǎo
transcript.en: (A) She likes cleaning.

transcript.zh: (B) 她喜歡做菜
transcript.py: (B) tā xǐhuān zuòcài
transcript.en: (B) She likes cooking.

transcript.zh: (C) 她喜歡洗衣服
transcript.py: (C) tā xǐhuān xǐyīfú
transcript.en: (C) She likes washing clothes.

transcript.zh: 提問：弟弟今天怎麼沒去上課？
transcript.py: Tíwèn: Dìdi jīntiān zěnme méi qù shàngkè?
transcript.en: Question: Why didn't younger brother go to class today?

transcript.zh: (A) 他腳痛
transcript.py: (A) tā jiǎotòng
transcript.en: (A) His foot hurts.

transcript.zh: (B) 他頭痛
transcript.py: (B) tā tóutòng
transcript.en: (B) He has a headache.

transcript.zh: (C) 他肚子痛
transcript.py: (C) tā dùzitòng
transcript.en: (C) He has a stomachache.

transcript.zh: 提問：小明給美美什麼？
transcript.py: Tíwèn: Xiǎomíng gěi Měiměi shénme?
transcript.en: Question: What did Xiaoming give Meimei?

transcript.zh: (A) 水果
transcript.py: (A) shuǐguǒ
transcript.en: (A) Fruit

transcript.zh: (B) 蛋糕
transcript.py: (B) dàngāo
transcript.en: (B) Cake

transcript.zh: (C) 餃子
transcript.py: (C) jiǎozi
transcript.en: (C) Dumplings

transcript.zh: 提問：這位先生現在在做什麼？
transcript.py: Tíwèn: Zhèwèi xiānsheng xiànzài zài zuò shénme?
transcript.en: Question: What is this gentleman doing now?

transcript.zh: (A) 他在教室上網
transcript.py: (A) tā zài jiàoshì shàngwǎng
transcript.en: (A) He is using the internet in the classroom.

transcript.zh: (B) 他在辦公室工作
transcript.py: (B) tā zài bàngōngshì gōngzuò
transcript.en: (B) He is working in the office.

transcript.zh: (C) 他在辦公室上網
transcript.py: (C) tā zài bàngōngshì shàngwǎng
transcript.en: (C) He is using the internet in the office.

transcript.zh: 提問：小女孩在做什麼？
transcript.py: Tíwèn: Xiǎonǚhái zài zuò shénme?
transcript.en: Question: What is the little girl doing?

transcript.zh: (A) 她在寄信
transcript.py: (A) tā zài jìxìn
transcript.en: (A) She is mailing a letter.

transcript.zh: (B) 她在寫信
transcript.py: (B) tā zài xiěxìn
transcript.en: (B) She is writing a letter.

transcript.zh: (C) 她在打電話
transcript.py: (C) tā zài dǎdiànhuà
transcript.en: (C) She is making a phone call.

transcript.zh: 提問：圖片裡有什麼？
transcript.py: Tíwèn: Túpiàn lǐ yǒu shénme?
transcript.en: Question: What is in the picture?

transcript.zh: (A) 一枝鉛筆和兩本字典
transcript.py: (A) yìzhī qiānbǐ hé liǎngběn zìdiǎn
transcript.en: (A) A pencil and two dictionaries

transcript.zh: (B) 一本字典和兩支毛筆
transcript.py: (B) yìběn zìdiǎn hé liǎngzhī máobǐ
transcript.en: (B) A dictionary and two writing brushes

transcript.zh: (C) 一本雜誌和兩本課本
transcript.py: (C) yìběn zázhì hé liǎngběn kèběn
transcript.en: (C) A magazine and two textbooks

transcript.zh: 提問：他們在做什麼？
transcript.py: Tíwèn: Tāmen zài zuò shénme?
transcript.en: Question: What are they doing?

transcript.zh: (A) 他們一邊看電視，一邊吃東西
transcript.py: (A) tāmen yìbiān kàndiànshì, yìbiān chī Dōngxi
transcript.en: (A) They are eating while watching TV.

transcript.zh: (B) 他們一邊吃東西，一邊和狗玩
transcript.py: (B) tāmen yìbiān chī Dōngxi, yìbiān hé gǒu wán
transcript.en: (B) They are playing with the dog while eating.

transcript.zh: (C) 他們一邊和狗玩，一邊看電視
transcript.py: (C) tāmen yìbiān hé gǒu wán, yìbiān kàndiànshì
transcript.en: (C) They are watching TV while playing with the dog.

transcript.zh: 提問：這裡有哪些動物？
transcript.py: Tíwèn: Zhèlǐ yǒu nǎxiē dòngwù?
transcript.en: Question: What animals are here?

transcript.zh: (A) 這裡都是馬
transcript.py: (A) zhèlǐ dōu shì mǎ
transcript.en: (A) They are all horses here.

transcript.zh: (B) 這裡有馬也有牛
transcript.py: (B) zhèlǐ yǒu mǎ yě yǒu niú
transcript.en: (B) There are horses and cows here.

transcript.zh: (C) 這裡只有牛沒有馬
transcript.py: (C) zhèlǐ zhǐyǒu niú méiyǒu mǎ
transcript.en: (C) There are only cows here, no horses.

transcript.zh: 男：剛剛那個年輕人在飯店裡吃了什麼食物？
transcript.py: Nán: Gānggāng nà ge niánqīngrén zài fàndiàn lǐ chī le shénme shíwù?
transcript.en: Man: What food did that young man just eat at the restaurant?

transcript.zh: 女：他吃了一碗麵。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Tā chī le yìwǎn miàn.
transcript.en: Woman: He ate a bowl of noodles.

transcript.zh: 女：你要不要去博物館？
transcript.py: Nǚ: Nǐ yào búyào qù bówùguǎn?
transcript.en: Woman: Do you want to go to the museum?

transcript.zh: 男：好啊！
transcript.py: Nán: Hǎo a!
transcript.en: Man: Sure!

transcript.zh: 男：這是您的巧克力蛋糕，請問還需要什麼嗎？
transcript.py: Nán: Zhè shì nín de Qiǎokèlì dàngāo, qǐngwèn hái xūyào shénme ma?
transcript.en: Man: Here's your chocolate cake. Do you need anything else?

transcript.zh: 女：請再給我一個湯匙，我們要一起吃。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Qǐng zài gěi wǒ yí ge tāngchí, wǒmen yào yìqǐ chī.
transcript.en: Woman: Please give me another spoon; we're going to share it.

transcript.zh: 女：我昨天打電話給你，你怎麼沒接電話？
transcript.py: Nǚ: Wǒ zuótiān dǎdiànhuà gěi nǐ, nǐ zěnme méi jiēdiànhuà?
transcript.en: Woman: I called you yesterday. Why didn't you answer?

transcript.zh: 男：我的手機壞了。
transcript.py: Nán: Wǒ de shǒujī huài le.
transcript.en: Man: My cell phone is broken.

transcript.zh: 男：哪一個是妳的妹妹？
transcript.py: Nán: Nǎ yí ge shì nǐ de mèimei?
transcript.en: Man: Which one is your younger sister?

transcript.zh: 女：那個短頭髮，戴眼鏡的是我妹妹。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Nà ge duǎn tóufà, Dàiyǎnjìng de shì wǒ mèimei.
transcript.en: Woman: The one with short hair and glasses is my younger sister.

transcript.zh: 女：這家店為什麼這麼多人在排隊？
transcript.py: Nǚ: Zhèjiā diàn wèishénme zhème duō rén zài páiduì?
transcript.en: Woman: Why are so many people lining up at this shop?

transcript.zh: 男：因為這裡的衣服很便宜，很多人來這裡買衣服。
transcript.py: Nán: Yīnwèi zhèlǐ de yīfú hěn piányi, hěnduō rén lái zhèlǐ mǎi yīfú.
transcript.en: Man: Because the clothes here are very cheap; many people come here to buy clothes.

transcript.zh: 男：聽說這家店的牛排和漢堡很好吃，妳要試一試嗎？
transcript.py: Nán: Tīngshuō zhèjiā diàn de niúpái hé Hànbǎo hěn hǎochī, nǐ yào shìyíshì ma?
transcript.en: Man: I heard the steak and hamburgers here are very good. Do you want to try them?

transcript.zh: 女：我不能吃肉，請幫我點一份青菜。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Wǒ bùnéng chī ròu, qǐng bāng wǒ diǎn yífèn qīngcài.
transcript.en: Woman: I can't eat meat. Please order a plate of vegetables for me.

transcript.zh: 男：媽媽，我找了客廳和房間，怎麼都沒看見我新買的小說？
transcript.py: Nán: Māma, wǒ zhǎo le kètīng hé fángjiān, zěnme dōu méi kànjiàn wǒ xīnmǎi de xiǎoshuō?
transcript.en: Man: Mom, I searched the living room and my bedroom; how come I can't find the novel I just bought?

transcript.zh: 女：你昨天放在浴室裡了。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Nǐ zuótiān fàngzài yùshì lǐ le.
transcript.en: Woman: You left it in the bathroom yesterday.

transcript.zh: 女：我上次送你的畫你放在哪裡了？
transcript.py: Nǚ: Wǒ shàngcì sòng nǐ de huà nǐ fàngzài nǎlǐ le?
transcript.en: Woman: Where did you put the painting I gave you last time?

transcript.zh: 男：我把它掛在冰箱後面的牆上了。
transcript.py: Nán: Wǒ bǎ tā guà zài bīngxiāng hòumiàn de qiángshàng le.
transcript.en: Man: I hung it on the wall behind the refrigerator.

transcript.zh: 男：聽說小美要表演，是鋼琴表演嗎？
transcript.py: Nán: Tīngshuō xiǎo měi yào biǎoyǎn, shì gāngqín biǎoyǎn ma?
transcript.en: Man: I heard Xiaomei is going to perform. Is it a piano performance?

transcript.zh: 女：她以前表演過鋼琴，但是這次是吉他表演。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Tā yǐqián biǎoyǎn guò gāngqín, dànshì zhècì shì Jítā biǎoyǎn.
transcript.en: Woman: She has performed piano before, but this time it's a guitar performance.

transcript.zh: 女：已經晚上九點了，辦公室裡怎麼還有人？
transcript.py: Nǚ: Yǐjīng wǎnshàng jiǔdiǎn le, bàngōngshì lǐ zěnme háiyǒu rén?
transcript.en: Woman: It's already 9 p.m. Why is there still someone in the office?

transcript.zh: 男：是蘇經理和小蔡，他們兩個還在開會。
transcript.py: Nán: Shì Sū jīnglǐ hé xiǎo Cài, tāmen liǎng ge hái zài kāihuì.
transcript.en: Man: It's Manager Su and Xiao Cai; the two of them are still in a meeting.

transcript.zh: 男：他們兩個人都很生氣，不知道他們在說什麼？
transcript.py: Nán: Tāmen liǎng ge rén dōu hěn shēngqì, bù zhīdào tāmen zài shuō shénme?
transcript.en: Man: They both look angry. I wonder what they're talking about?

transcript.zh: 女：他們一討論小孩的事情，就會不太開心。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Tāmen yì tǎolùn xiǎohái de shìqing, jiù huì bú tài kāixīn.
transcript.en: Woman: Whenever they discuss things about the children, they get unhappy.

transcript.zh: 女：為什麼他今天沒來上班？
transcript.py: Nǚ: Wèishénme tā jīntiān méi lái shàngbān?
transcript.en: Woman: Why didn't he come to work today?

transcript.zh: 男：因為他在家裡準備明天的報告。
transcript.py: Nán: Yīnwèi tā zài jiālǐ zhǔnbèi míngtiān de bàogào.
transcript.en: Man: Because he's at home preparing tomorrow's report.

transcript.zh: 女：你們在山上新租的房子怎麼樣？
transcript.py: Nǚ: Nǐmen zài shānshàng xīnzū de fángzi zěnmeyàng?
transcript.en: Woman: How's the house you newly rented in the mountains?

transcript.zh: 男：房子很不錯。樓下房間有一個大窗戶。
transcript.py: Nán: Fángzi hěn búcuò. Lóuxià fángjiān yǒu yí ge dà chuānghù.
transcript.en: Man: The house is great. The room downstairs has a big window.

transcript.zh: 男：美美，我的那件短袖襯衫呢？
transcript.py: Nán: Měiměi, wǒ de nàjiàn duǎnxiù chènshān ne?
transcript.en: Man: Meimei, where's my short-sleeved shirt?

transcript.zh: 女：我剛洗好，現在還沒乾喔！
transcript.py: Nǚ: Wǒ gāng xǐ hǎo, xiànzài hái méi gān ō!
transcript.en: Woman: I just washed it; it's not dry yet!

transcript.zh: 男：聽說小明家附近的風景很漂亮，是嗎？
transcript.py: Nán: Tīngshuō Xiǎomíngjiā fùjìn de fēngjǐng hěnpiàoliang, shì ma?
transcript.en: Man: I heard the scenery near Xiaoming's home is beautiful, right?

transcript.zh: 女：是啊！但是那裡冬天的溫度很低，你去找他要穿暖一點。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Shì a! Dànshì nàlǐ dōngtiān de wēndù hěn dī, nǐ qù zhǎo tā yào chuān nuǎn yìdiǎn.
transcript.en: Woman: Yes! But the temperature there is very low in winter; dress warmly when you go see him.

transcript.zh: 女：你覺得認識臺灣最好的方法是什麼？
transcript.py: Nǚ: Nǐ juéde rènshi Táiwān zuìhǎo de fāngfǎ shì shénme?
transcript.en: Woman: What do you think is the best way to get to know Taiwan?

transcript.zh: 男：看書、看電視介紹都不錯，但是最好的方法就是你自己去旅行。
transcript.py: Nán: Kànshū, kàndiànshì jièshào dōu búcuò, dànshì zuìhǎo de fāngfǎ jiùshì nǐ zìjǐ qù lǚxíng.
transcript.en: Man: Reading books and watching TV introductions are both good, but the best way is to travel there yourself.

transcript.zh: 男：小美，你的新家怎麼樣？
transcript.py: Nán: Xiǎoměi, nǐ de xīnjiā zěnmeyàng?
transcript.en: Man: Xiaomei, how's your new home?

transcript.zh: 女：別說了，我搬到公寓去，結果樓上的小孩經常往下丟垃圾，環境非常髒。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Biéshuō le, wǒ bāndào gōngyù qù, jiéguǒ lóushàng de xiǎohái jīngcháng wǎng xià diū lājī, huánjìng fēicháng zàng.
transcript.en: Woman: Don't ask. I moved into an apartment, and the kids upstairs often throw trash down; the surroundings are really dirty.

transcript.zh: 男：我們等一下三點在書店門口前見面嗎？
transcript.py: Nán: Wǒmen děng yíxià sāndiǎn zài shūdiàn ménkǒu qián jiànmiàn ma?
transcript.en: Man: Are we meeting in front of the bookstore entrance at three later?

transcript.zh: 女：我覺得有一點晚，我們可以早半個小時嗎？
transcript.py: Nǚ: Wǒ juéde yǒu yìdiǎn wǎn, wǒmen kěyǐ zǎo bàn ge xiǎoshí ma?
transcript.en: Woman: I think that's a bit late. Can we make it half an hour earlier?

transcript.zh: 男：好啊，那一樣在書店門口前見嗎？
transcript.py: Nán: Hǎo a, nà yíyàng zài shūdiàn ménkǒu qián jiàn ma?
transcript.en: Man: OK. Still meeting in front of the bookstore entrance?

transcript.zh: 女：對，書店門口見！
transcript.py: Nǚ: Duì, shūdiàn ménkǒu jiàn!
transcript.en: Woman: Yes, see you at the bookstore entrance!

transcript.zh: 男：請問他們幾點見面？
transcript.py: Nán: Qǐngwèn tāmen jǐdiǎn jiànmiàn?
transcript.en: Man: What time are they meeting?

transcript.zh: 男：請問妳要找什麼書？
transcript.py: Nán: Qǐngwèn nǐ yào zhǎo shénme shū?
transcript.en: Man: What book are you looking for?

transcript.zh: 女：我正在找介紹日本風景的旅遊書。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Wǒ zhèngzài zhǎo jièshào Rìběn fēngjǐng de lǚyóu shū.
transcript.en: Woman: I'm looking for a travel book introducing Japanese scenery.

transcript.zh: 男：妳看到上面號碼了嗎？如果妳要找日本的書，那在中間 2 號。
transcript.py: Nán: Nǐ kàndào shàngmiàn hàomǎ le ma? Rúguǒ nǐ yào zhǎo Rìběn de shū, nà zài zhōngjiān 2 hào.
transcript.en: Man: Do you see the numbers up there? If you're looking for books on Japan, they're in the middle, number 2.

transcript.zh: 女：謝謝。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Xièxiè.
transcript.en: Woman: Thank you.

transcript.zh: 男：請問介紹日本風景的書放在哪裡？
transcript.py: Nán: Qǐngwèn jièshào Rìběn fēngjǐng de shū fàngzài nǎlǐ?
transcript.en: Man: Where are the books introducing Japanese scenery?

transcript.zh: 男：來這家店的人真多。
transcript.py: Nán: Lái zhèjiā diàn de rén zhēnduō.
transcript.en: Man: So many people come to this shop.

transcript.zh: 女：是啊！這家冰淇淋店有很多種味道的冰淇淋。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Shì a! Zhèjiā Bīngqílín diàn yǒu hěn duōzhǒng wèidào de Bīngqílín.
transcript.en: Woman: Yes! This ice cream shop has many flavors of ice cream.

transcript.zh: 男：我想吃巧克力和牛奶口味的，我們進去吃吧！
transcript.py: Nán: Wǒ xiǎng chī Qiǎokèlì hé niúnǎi kǒuwèi de, wǒmen jìnqù chī ba!
transcript.en: Man: I want chocolate and milk flavors. Let's go in and eat!

transcript.zh: 女：好，我請客。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Hǎo, wǒ qǐngkè.
transcript.en: Woman: OK, my treat.

transcript.zh: 男：請問他們等一下要做什麼？
transcript.py: Nán: Qǐngwèn tāmen děng yíxià yào zuò shénme?
transcript.en: Man: What are they going to do in a moment?

transcript.zh: 男：照片裡這些人是妳的家人嗎？你們在哪裡拍的？
transcript.py: Nán: Zhàopiān lǐ zhèxiē rén shì nǐ de jiārén ma? Nǐmen zài nǎlǐ pāi de?
transcript.en: Man: Are these people in the photo your family? Where did you take it?

transcript.zh: 女：是啊，這是我的爸爸媽媽。這張照片是在船上拍的。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Shì a, zhè shì wǒ de Bàbamāma. Zhè zhāng zhàopiān shì zài chuánshàng pāi de.
transcript.en: Woman: Yes, these are my dad and mom. This photo was taken on a boat.

transcript.zh: 男：這個戴帽子的人是誰？
transcript.py: Nán: Zhè ge Dàimàozi de rén shì shuí?
transcript.en: Man: Who is this person wearing a hat?

transcript.zh: 女：這是我爺爺。他已經七十歲了。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Zhè shì wǒ yéyé. Tā yǐjīng qīshísuì le.
transcript.en: Woman: This is my grandpa. He's already seventy.

transcript.zh: 男：請問他們說的是哪一張照片？
transcript.py: Nán: Qǐngwèn tāmen shuō de shì nǎ yìzhāng zhàopiān?
transcript.en: Man: Which photo are they talking about?

transcript.zh: 男：要不要喝點兒啤酒？
transcript.py: Nán: Yào búyào hē diǎnr píjiǔ?
transcript.en: Man: Do you want some beer?

transcript.zh: 女：不行，我等一下要開車。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Bùxíng, wǒ děng yíxià yào kāichē.
transcript.en: Woman: No, I have to drive in a while.

transcript.zh: 男：那，喝點兒汽水吧？
transcript.py: Nán: Nà, hē diǎnr qìshuǐ ba?
transcript.en: Man: Then how about some soda?

transcript.zh: 女：我還是喝茶好了。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Wǒ háishì hēchá hǎo le.
transcript.en: Woman: I think I'll just have tea.

transcript.zh: 男：請問這位小姐決定喝什麼？
transcript.py: Nán: Qǐngwèn zhèwèi Xiǎojiě juédìng hē shénme?
transcript.en: Man: What did this young lady decide to drink?

transcript.zh: 男：妳的房間這麼亂，為什麼不整理？
transcript.py: Nán: Nǐ de fángjiān zhème luàn, wèishénme bù zhěnglǐ?
transcript.en: Man: Your room is so messy. Why don't you tidy it?

transcript.zh: 女：我本來上星期日要整理房間，但是我的經理要我去公司。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Wǒ běnlái shàng xīngqīrì yào zhěnglǐ fángjiān, dànshì wǒ de jīnglǐ yào wǒ qù gōngsī.
transcript.en: Woman: I was going to tidy my room last Sunday, but my manager asked me to go to the office.

transcript.zh: 男：那妳今天看了一個下午的書，為什麼不打掃？
transcript.py: Nán: Nà nǐ jīntiān kàn le yí ge xiàwǔ de shū, wèishénme bù dǎsǎo?
transcript.en: Man: Then today you spent the whole afternoon reading—why didn't you clean?

transcript.zh: 女：好啦！我明天會整理。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Hǎo la! Wǒ míngtiān huì zhěnglǐ.
transcript.en: Woman: All right! I'll tidy it tomorrow.

transcript.zh: 男：請問這位小姐明天打算做什麼？
transcript.py: Nán: Qǐngwèn zhèwèi Xiǎojiě míngtiān dǎsuàn zuò shénme?
transcript.en: Man: What is this young lady planning to do tomorrow?

transcript.zh: 男：這裡的天氣怎麼樣？
transcript.py: Nán: Zhèlǐ de tiānqì zěnmeyàng?
transcript.en: Man: What's the weather like here?

transcript.zh: 女：冬天太冷，夏天太熱。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Dōngtiān Tàilěng, xiàtiān tài rè.
transcript.en: Woman: Winter is too cold and summer is too hot.

transcript.zh: 男：那麼春天呢？
transcript.py: Nán: Nàme chūntiān ne?
transcript.en: Man: What about spring?

transcript.zh: 女：常常下雨。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Chángcháng xiàyǔ.
transcript.en: Woman: It often rains.

transcript.zh: 男：請問這裡的春天常常怎麼樣？
transcript.py: Nán: Qǐngwèn zhèlǐ de chūntiān chángcháng zěnmeyàng?
transcript.en: Man: What is spring here often like?

transcript.zh: 男：我想找王先生。
transcript.py: Nán: Wǒ xiǎng zhǎo Wángxiānsheng.
transcript.en: Man: I'm looking for Mr. Wang.

transcript.zh: 女：請問您和他約好了嗎？
transcript.py: Nǚ: Qǐngwèn nín hé tā yuē hǎolema?
transcript.en: Woman: Do you have an appointment with him?

transcript.zh: 男：沒有。是他要我來找他的。
transcript.py: Nán: Méiyǒu. Shì tā yào wǒ lái zhǎo tā de.
transcript.en: Man: No. He asked me to come see him.

transcript.zh: 女：您先留下您的電話，我會請王先生打電話給您。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Nín xiān liúxià nín de diànhuà, wǒhuì qǐng Wángxiānsheng dǎdiànhuà gěi nín.
transcript.en: Woman: Please leave your phone number first, and I'll have Mr. Wang call you.

transcript.zh: 男：請問這位小姐要這位先生做什麼？
transcript.py: Nán: Qǐngwèn zhèwèi Xiǎojiě yào zhèwèi xiānsheng zuò shénme?
transcript.en: Man: What does this young lady want this gentleman to do?

transcript.zh: 男：小春的生日快到了，我們一起送他禮物，怎麼樣？
transcript.py: Nán: Xiǎochūn de shēngrì kuài dào le, wǒmen yìqǐ sòng tā lǐwù, zěnmeyàng?
transcript.en: Man: Xiaochun's birthday is coming. Let's give him a present together, how about it?

transcript.zh: 女：好啊！他喜歡畫畫，我們可以送他畫畫用的筆。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Hǎo a! Tā xǐhuān huàhuà, wǒmen kěyǐ sòng tā huàhuà yòng de bǐ.
transcript.en: Woman: Sure! He likes drawing; we can give him pens for drawing.

transcript.zh: 男：嗯，還可以送他放筆的袋子。
transcript.py: Nán: ń, hái kěyǐ sòng tā fàngbǐ de dàizi.
transcript.en: Man: Yes, and we can also give him a bag to keep the pens in.

transcript.zh: 女：好啊，今天下課以後我們一起去買禮物吧。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Hǎo a, jīntiān xiàkè yǐhòu wǒmen yìqǐ qù mǎi lǐwù ba.
transcript.en: Woman: OK, let's go buy the present together after class today.

transcript.zh: 男：請問他們決定送什麼？
transcript.py: Nán: Qǐngwèn tāmen juédìng sòng shénme?
transcript.en: Man: What did they decide to give?

transcript.zh: 男：妳看電視新聞了嗎？有一個很可怕的消息。
transcript.py: Nán: Nǐ kàndiànshì xīnwén le ma? Yǒu yí ge hěn kěpà de xiāoxī.
transcript.en: Man: Did you see the TV news? There was some terrible news.

transcript.zh: 女：什麼可怕的消息？
transcript.py: Nǚ: Shénme kěpà de xiāoxī?
transcript.en: Woman: What terrible news?

transcript.zh: 男：妳快點開電視，我剛剛才看到的。
transcript.py: Nán: Nǐ kuàidiǎn kāi diànshì, wǒ gānggāng cái kàndào de.
transcript.en: Man: Turn on the TV quickly; I just saw it.

transcript.zh: 女：我上網看過新聞了，可是沒看到什麼可怕的消息。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Wǒ shàngwǎng kànguò xīnwén le, kěshì méi kàndào shénme kěpà de xiāoxī.
transcript.en: Woman: I've read the news online, but I didn't see any terrible news.

transcript.zh: 男：請問這位先生從哪裡知道可怕的消息？
transcript.py: Nán: Qǐngwèn zhèwèi xiānsheng cóng nǎlǐ zhīdào kěpà de xiāoxī?
transcript.en: Man: Where did this gentleman learn about the terrible news?

transcript.zh: 男：妳想吃什麼?
transcript.py: Nán: Nǐ xiǎng chī shénme?
transcript.en: Man: What would you like to eat?

transcript.zh: 女：聽說這裡的北京烤鴨很好吃。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Tīngshuō zhèlǐ de běijīngkǎoyā hěn hǎochī.
transcript.en: Woman: I heard the Peking duck here is very good.

transcript.zh: 男：我們點一隻烤鴨，一碗酸辣湯，怎麼樣？
transcript.py: Nán: Wǒmen diǎn yìzhī kǎoyā, yìwǎn Suānlàtāng, zěnmeyàng?
transcript.en: Man: Let's order a roast duck and a bowl of hot and sour soup, how about that?

transcript.zh: 女：再點一個糖醋魚吧！
transcript.py: Nǚ: Zàidiǎn yí ge tángcùyú ba!
transcript.en: Woman: Let's also order a sweet and sour fish!

transcript.zh: 男：請問他們應該在什麼地方？
transcript.py: Nán: Qǐngwèn tāmen yīnggāi zài shénme dìfāng?
transcript.en: Man: Where should they be?

transcript.zh: 男：已經很晚了，妳怎麼還在這裡？
transcript.py: Nán: Yǐjīng hěn wǎn le, nǐ zěnme hái zài zhèlǐ?
transcript.en: Man: It's already very late. Why are you still here?

transcript.zh: 女：經理說明天要和他一起討論，我今天一定要準備好。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Jīnglǐ shuō míngtiān yào hé tā yìqǐ tǎolùn, wǒ jīntiān yídìng yào zhǔnbèi hǎo.
transcript.en: Woman: The manager said he wants to discuss things with me tomorrow; I have to get everything ready today.

transcript.zh: 男：我不放心妳一個人回家，還是等會兒我開車送妳回去。
transcript.py: Nán: Wǒ bú fàngxīn nǐ yí ge rén huíjiā, háishì děnghuìr wǒ kāichē sòng nǐ huíqù.
transcript.en: Man: I don't feel comfortable with you going home alone; I'll drive you back in a bit.

transcript.zh: 女：謝謝你！但是我今天晚上打算睡在公司裡。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Xièxiè nǐ! Dànshì wǒ jīntiān wǎnshàng dǎsuàn shuì zài gōngsī lǐ.
transcript.en: Woman: Thank you! But I'm planning to sleep at the office tonight.

transcript.zh: 男：請問這位小姐今天晚上打算做什麼？
transcript.py: Nán: Qǐngwèn zhèwèi Xiǎojiě jīntiān wǎnshàng dǎsuàn zuò shénme?
transcript.en: Man: What is this young lady planning to do tonight?

C.en: Because he doesn't want to work

D.en: Because he can't get out of bed

transcript.zh: 男：我昨天運動了一整天。
transcript.py: Nán: Wǒ zuótiān yùndòng le yìzhěngtiān.
transcript.en: Man: I exercised the whole day yesterday.

transcript.zh: 女：你看你，累到說不了話了？
transcript.py: Nǚ: Nǐ kàn nǐ, lèidào shuō bùliǎo huà le?
transcript.en: Woman: Look at you—so tired you can't even talk?

transcript.zh: 男：喔，不是因為運動，是因為我早上五點就起床了，所以想睡覺。
transcript.py: Nán: Ō, búshì yīnwèi yùndòng, shìyīnwèi wǒ zǎoshàng wǔdiǎn jiù qǐchuáng le, suǒyǐ xiǎng shuìjiào.
transcript.en: Man: Oh, it's not because of exercise; it's because I got up at five this morning, so I want to sleep.

transcript.zh: 女：你這樣沒辦法上班，我幫你請假，你快回去睡吧！
transcript.py: Nǚ: Nǐ zhèyàng méi bànfǎ shàngbān, wǒ bāng nǐ qǐngjià, nǐ kuàihuíqù shuì ba!
transcript.en: Woman: You can't work like this. I'll ask for leave for you—go back and sleep!

transcript.zh: 男：請問這位小姐為什麼要幫這位先生請假？
transcript.py: Nán: Qǐngwèn zhèwèi Xiǎojiě wèishénme yào bāng zhèwèi xiānsheng qǐngjià?
transcript.en: Man: Why does this young lady want to ask for leave for this gentleman?

A.zh: 她旅行時不小心掉了東西
A.py: Tā lǚxíng shí bù xiǎoxīn diào le Dōngxi
A.en: She accidentally lost something while traveling.

B.zh: 她旅行時有些想去的地方沒去
B.py: Tā lǚxíng shí yǒuxiē xiǎngqù de dìfāng méi qù
B.en: There were some places she wanted to go but didn't on her trip.

C.zh: 她覺得旅行時最麻煩的是交通
C.py: Tā juéde lǚxíng shí zuì máfán de shì jiāotōng
C.en: She feels transportation is the most troublesome part of traveling.

D.zh: 她覺得旅行最重要的是風景漂亮
D.py: Tā juéde lǚxíng zuì zhòngyào de shì fēngjǐng piàoliang
D.en: She feels the most important thing about traveling is beautiful scenery.

transcript.zh: 男：妳上個禮拜的旅行怎麼樣？
transcript.py: Nán: Nǐ shàng gè Lǐbài de lǚxíng zěnmeyàng?
transcript.en: Man: How was your trip last week?

transcript.zh: 女：還不錯。交通方便、風景漂亮，我想去的地方都去了。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Hái búcuò. Jiāotōng fāngbiàn, fēngjǐng piàoliang, wǒ xiǎngqù de dìfāng dōu qù le.
transcript.en: Woman: Pretty good. Transportation was convenient, the scenery was beautiful, and I went everywhere I wanted to.

transcript.zh: 男：那真是個開心的旅行。
transcript.py: Nán: Nà zhēnshì gè kāixīn de lǚxíng.
transcript.en: Man: That really was a happy trip.

transcript.zh: 女：嗯，雖然每件事都不錯，但是我回國的時候，把錢包掉在旅館了。
transcript.py: Nǚ: ń, suīrán měijiànshì dōu búcuò, dànshì wǒ Huíguó de shíhòu, bǎ qiánbāo diào zài lǚguǎn le.
transcript.en: Woman: Yes. Although everything was good, when I was returning home I lost my wallet at the hotel.

transcript.zh: 男：關於這位小姐，下面哪一個是對的？
transcript.py: Nán: Guānyú zhèwèi Xiǎojiě, xiàmiàn nǎ yí ge shì duì de?
transcript.en: Man: Regarding this young lady, which of the following is correct?

A.en: She's afraid she did badly on the exam.

D.py: Tā pà tímù xiě bù wán
D.en: She's afraid she can't finish the questions.

transcript.zh: 男：妳怎麼了？好像不太開心的樣子。
transcript.py: Nán: Nǐ zěnme le? Hǎoxiàng bú tài kāixīn de yàngzi.
transcript.en: Man: What's wrong? You don't seem very happy.

transcript.zh: 女：我沒事，我每次考試的時候就會這樣。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Wǒ méishì, wǒ měicì kǎoshì de shíhòu jiù huì zhèyàng.
transcript.en: Woman: I'm fine. I'm always like this when I have an exam.

transcript.zh: 男：可是昨天不是已經考完了嗎？
transcript.py: Nán: Kěshì zuótiān búshì yǐjīng kǎowán le ma?
transcript.en: Man: But didn't you already finish the exam yesterday?

transcript.zh: 女：是啊，可是我很擔心沒考好。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Shì a, kěshì wǒ hěn dānxīn méikǎo hǎo.
transcript.en: Woman: Yes, but I'm worried I didn't do well.

transcript.zh: 男：這位小姐為什麼不開心？
transcript.py: Nán: Zhèwèi Xiǎojiě wèishénme bù kāixīn?
transcript.en: Man: Why is this young lady unhappy?

A.en: She wants to ask him to move.

B.en: She wants to invite him to dinner.

C.en: To introduce a girlfriend to him

D.py: Qǐng tā zhùyì shēngyīn de dàxiǎo
D.en: To ask him to watch how loud he is

transcript.zh: 女：王先生嗎？您好，我是住在您家樓下的陳太太。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Wángxiānsheng ma? Nínhǎo, wǒ shì zhù zài nín jiā lóuxià de Chéntàitai.
transcript.en: Woman: Mr. Wang? Hello, I'm Mrs. Chen, who lives downstairs from you.

transcript.zh: 男：請問有什麼事嗎？
transcript.py: Nán: Qǐngwèn yǒu shénme shì ma?
transcript.en: Man: What can I do for you?

transcript.zh: 女：我總是聽到您走路的聲音，有時還聽到您與女朋友大聲地講話。我找您好
transcript.py: Nǚ: Wǒ zǒngshì tīngdào nín zǒulù de shēngyīn, yǒushí hái tīngdào nín yǔ nǚpéngyǒu dàshēng de jiǎnghuà. Wǒ zhǎo nínhǎo
transcript.en: Woman: I always hear the sound of you walking, and sometimes I hear you talking loudly with your girlfriend. I've come looking for you

transcript.zh: 幾次了，可是您都不在家。
transcript.py: Jǐcì le, kěshì nín dōu bú zàijiā.
transcript.en: (continued) several times, but you're never home.

transcript.zh: 男：啊！不好意思，不好意思，我會注意的。
transcript.py: Nán: A! Bùhǎoyìsī, bùhǎoyìsī, wǒhuì zhùyì de.
transcript.en: Man: Oh! Sorry, sorry, I'll be careful.

transcript.zh: 女：陳太太為什麼找王先生？
transcript.py: Nǚ: Chéntàitai wèishénme zhǎo Wángxiānsheng?
transcript.en: Woman: Why did Mrs. Chen look for Mr. Wang?

A.zh: 她習慣在不同的時間睡覺
A.py: Tā xíguàn zài bùtóng de shíjiān shuìjiào
A.en: She's used to sleeping at different times.

B.zh: 她每天都是這個時間起床
B.py: Tā měitiān dōu shì zhè ge shíjiān qǐchuáng
B.en: She gets up at this time every day.

C.zh: 她認為睡覺對健康有影響
C.py: Tā rènwéi shuìjiào duì jiànkāng yǒu yǐngxiǎng

D.zh: 她不覺得自己很晚才睡覺
D.py: Tā bù juéde zìjǐ hěn wǎncái shuìjiào
D.en: She doesn't feel she went to bed very late.

transcript.zh: 男：妳昨天怎麼那麼晚才睡？
transcript.py: Nán: Nǐ zuótiān zěnme nàme wǎncái shuì?
transcript.en: Man: Why did you go to bed so late yesterday?

transcript.zh: 女：我昨天十二點多睡的，我不覺得晚啊！
transcript.py: Nǚ: Wǒ zuótiān shí'èrdiǎn duō shuì de, wǒ bù juéde wǎn a!
transcript.en: Woman: I went to bed after twelve yesterday; I don't think that's late!

transcript.zh: 男：都半夜了，還不晚？這麼晚才睡覺對身體很不好。
transcript.py: Nán: Dōu bànyè le, hái bù wǎn? Zhèmewǎn cái shuìjiào duì shēntǐ hěn bùhǎo.
transcript.en: Man: It's already midnight and that's not late? Going to bed this late is very bad for your health.

transcript.zh: 女：還好吧？我一直都是這個時間睡覺，也沒生什麼病。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Háihǎo ba? Wǒ yìzhí dōu shì zhè ge shíjiān shuìjiào, yě méishēng shénme bìng.
transcript.en: Woman: Is it? I always go to bed at this time, and I haven't gotten sick.

transcript.zh: 女：請問這位小姐的意思是什麼？
transcript.py: Nǚ: Qǐngwèn zhèwèi Xiǎojiě de yìsi shì shénme?
transcript.en: Woman: What does this young lady mean?

A.en: He just came back from the beach.

B.py: Tā xǐhuān xiàtiān qù hǎibiān wán
B.en: He likes going to the beach in summer.

C.zh: 他給這位小姐買了褲子
C.py: Tā gěi zhèwèi Xiǎojiě mǎi le kùzi
C.en: He bought pants for this young lady.

D.zh: 他約了這位小姐明天去運動
D.py: Tā yuē le zhèwèi Xiǎojiě míngtiān qù yùndòng
D.en: He has arranged to exercise with this young lady tomorrow.

transcript.zh: 男：夏天到了，我們明天去海邊吧！
transcript.py: Nán: Xiàtiān dào le, wǒmen míngtiān qù hǎibiān ba!
transcript.en: Man: Summer's here—let's go to the beach tomorrow!

transcript.zh: 女：好啊！你覺得我應該穿短裙好呢？還是短褲好呢？
transcript.py: Nǚ: Hǎo a! Nǐ juéde wǒ yīnggāi chuān duǎnqún hǎo ne? Háishì duǎnkù hǎo ne?
transcript.en: Woman: OK! Do you think I should wear a short skirt or shorts?

transcript.zh: 男：我覺得妳應該穿短褲，因為我們要在沙灘上打球。
transcript.py: Nán: Wǒ juéde nǐ yīnggāi chuān duǎnkù, yīnwèi wǒmen yào zài Shātān shàng dǎqiú.
transcript.en: Man: I think you should wear shorts, because we're going to play ball on the beach.

transcript.zh: 女：好啊，明天見。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Hǎo a, míngtiān jiàn.
transcript.en: Woman: OK, see you tomorrow.

transcript.zh: 女：請問這位先生說了什麼？
transcript.py: Nǚ: Qǐngwèn zhèwèi xiānsheng shuō le shénme?
transcript.en: Woman: What did this gentleman say?

A.zh: 她不想請這位先生吃蛋糕
A.py: Tā bùxiǎng qǐng zhèwèi xiānsheng chī dàngāo
A.en: She doesn't want to treat this gentleman to cake.

B.zh: 她想幫這位先生慶祝生日
B.py: Tā xiǎng bāng zhèwèi xiānsheng qìngzhù shēngrì
B.en: She wants to help this gentleman celebrate his birthday.

C.zh: 她要朋友來參加舞會就好
C.py: Tā yào péngyǒu lái cānjiā wǔhuì jiù hǎo
C.en: She only needs her friends to come to the party.

D.zh: 她想要大家一起唱生日歌
D.py: Tā xiǎngyào dàjiā yìqǐ chàng shēngrìgē
D.en: She wants everyone to sing "Happy Birthday" together.

transcript.zh: 男：為了妳的生日，我想請妳吃蛋糕。
transcript.py: Nán: Wèile nǐ de shēngrì, wǒ xiǎng qǐng nǐ chī dàngāo.
transcript.en: Man: For your birthday, I'd like to treat you to cake.

transcript.zh: 女：你人來我就很開心了，蛋糕，我來準備就好了。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Nǐ rén lái wǒ jiù hěn kāixīn le, dàngāo, wǒ lái zhǔnbèi jiù hǎo le.
transcript.en: Woman: Just you coming makes me very happy; I'll take care of the cake.

transcript.zh: 男：這是為了感謝妳請我參加明天的生日舞會，或是妳有更想要的禮物嗎？
transcript.py: Nán: Zhè shì wèile gǎnxiè nǐ qǐng wǒ cānjiā míngtiān de shēngrìwǔhuì, huòshì nǐyǒu gèng xiǎngyào de lǐwù ma?
transcript.en: Man: This is to thank you for inviting me to tomorrow's birthday party—or is there a present you'd like more?

transcript.zh: 女：你太客氣了。吃蛋糕和收禮物都不是最重要的事。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Nǐ tài kèqì le. Chī dàngāo hé shōu lǐwù dōu búshì zuì zhòngyào de shì.
transcript.en: Woman: You're too kind. Eating cake and receiving presents aren't the most important things.

transcript.zh: 女：請問這位小姐的意思是什麼？
transcript.py: Nǚ: Qǐngwèn zhèwèi Xiǎojiě de yìsi shì shénme?
transcript.en: Woman: What does this young lady mean?

A.py: Tā xiǎng ná shāngdiàn sòng de Dōngxi
A.en: She wants to get the free things the store gives out.

B.zh: 她最近很想花錢買東西
B.py: Tā zuìjìn hěn xiǎng Huāqiánmǎi Dōngxi
B.en: She really wants to spend money shopping lately.

C.zh: 她想要這位先生送她禮物
C.py: Tā xiǎngyào zhèwèi xiānsheng sòng tā lǐwù
C.en: She wants this gentleman to give her a present.

D.zh: 她想和這位先生一起去逛街
D.py: Tā xiǎng hé zhèwèi xiānsheng yìqǐ qù guàngjiē
D.en: She wants to go shopping with this gentleman.

transcript.zh: 男：我要去逛百貨公司，要一起嗎？
transcript.py: Nán: Wǒ yào qùguàng bǎihuògōngsī, yào yìqǐ ma?
transcript.en: Man: I'm going to the department store. Want to come along?

transcript.zh: 女：我最近花了太多錢了，還是不要吧。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Wǒ zuìjìn huā le tài duō qián le, háishì búyào ba.
transcript.en: Woman: I've spent too much money lately; I'd better not.

transcript.zh: 男：最近百貨公司有活動，很多商品不但很便宜，還會給很多試用的東西。
transcript.py: Nán: Zuìjìn bǎihuògōngsī yǒu huódòng, hěnduō shāngpǐn búdàn hěn piányi, hái huì gěi hěnduō shìyòng de Dōngxi.
transcript.en: Man: The department store is having a promotion lately; many items are not only cheap, but they also give out lots of free samples.

transcript.zh: 女：喔，有不用花錢的啊！那我們快走吧！
transcript.py: Nǚ: Ō, yǒu búyòng huāqián de a! Nà wǒmen kuài zǒu ba!
transcript.en: Woman: Oh, there's free stuff! Then let's hurry!

transcript.zh: 女：為什麼這位小姐想去百貨公司？
transcript.py: Nǚ: Wèishénme zhèwèi Xiǎojiě xiǎng qù bǎihuògōngsī?
transcript.en: Woman: Why does this young lady want to go to the department store?

A.zh: 這位先生今天想留在家裡
A.py: Zhèwèi xiānsheng jīntiān xiǎng liúzài jiālǐ
A.en: This gentleman wants to stay home today.

B.zh: 這位小姐怕自己太晚回家
B.py: Zhèwèi Xiǎojiě pà zìjǐ Tàiwǎn huíjiā
B.en: This young lady is afraid she'll get home too late.

C.zh: 他們兩人今天都想看棒球比賽
C.py: Tāmen liǎng rén jīntiān dōu xiǎng kàn bàngqiú bǐsài
C.en: They both want to watch the baseball game today.

D.zh: 他們已經買完衣服回家休息了
D.py: Tāmen yǐjīng mǎiwán yīfú huíjiā xiūxí le
D.en: They've already bought clothes and gone home to rest.

transcript.zh: 男：今天天氣好熱，我們在家吹冷氣多好，還是不要去買衣服了。
transcript.py: Nán: Jīntiāntiānqì hǎo rè, wǒmen zàijiā chuīlěngqì duō hǎo, háishì búyào qù mǎi yīfú le.
transcript.en: Man: It's so hot today. Wouldn't it be nice to stay home with the air conditioning? Let's not go clothes shopping.

transcript.zh: 女：不行，你昨天答應我今天要出門買衣服。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Bùxíng, nǐ zuótiān dāyìng wǒ jīntiān yào chūmén mǎi yīfú.
transcript.en: Woman: No way—yesterday you promised me we'd go out to buy clothes today.

transcript.zh: 男：可是妳沒發現衣服已經很多了嗎？
transcript.py: Nán: Kěshì nǐ méi fāxiàn yīfú yǐjīng hěnduō le ma?
transcript.en: Man: But haven't you noticed you already have lots of clothes?

transcript.zh: 女：我覺得，你只是怕太晚回家，沒辦法看棒球比賽！
transcript.py: Nǚ: Wǒ juéde, nǐ zhǐshì pà Tàiwǎn huíjiā, méi bànfǎ kàn bàngqiú bǐsài!
transcript.en: Woman: I think you're just afraid of getting home too late to watch the baseball game!

transcript.zh: 女：請問下面哪一個是對的？
transcript.py: Nǚ: Qǐngwèn xiàmiàn nǎ yí ge shì duì de?
transcript.en: Woman: Which of the following is correct?

A.py: Tā yào bǎ qián huángěi kèrén
A.en: She will give the money back to the customer.

B.zh: 東西賣出去就不能換了
B.py: Dōngxi màichūqù jiù bùnéng huàn le
B.en: Once goods are sold, they can't be exchanged.

C.zh: 她沒有東西可以換給客人
C.py: Tā méiyǒu Dōngxi kěyǐ huàn gěi kèrén
C.en: She has nothing to exchange for the customer.

D.zh: 沒有發票，就不能換東西
D.py: Méiyǒu fāpiào, jiù bùnéng Huàn Dōngxi
D.en: Without a receipt, items can't be exchanged.

transcript.zh: 男：小姐，這是昨天跟你們買的牛奶，味道有點奇怪，我想換一瓶新的。
transcript.py: Nán: Xiǎojiě, zhè shì zuótiān gēn nǐmen mǎi de niúnǎi, wèidào yǒudiǎn qíguài, wǒ xiǎnghuàn yìpíng xīn de.
transcript.en: Man: Miss, this is the milk I bought from you yesterday. It tastes a bit strange; I'd like to exchange it for a new bottle.

transcript.zh: 女：請問您帶了發票嗎？
transcript.py: Nǚ: Qǐngwèn nín dài le fāpiào ma?
transcript.en: Woman: Did you bring the receipt?

transcript.zh: 男：喔，我沒帶來。
transcript.py: Nán: Ō, wǒ méi dàilái.
transcript.en: Man: Oh, I didn't bring it.

transcript.zh: 女：我們要看到發票，才能換東西，不好意思。
transcript.py: Nǚ: Wǒmen yào kàndào fāpiào, cáinéng Huàn Dōngxi, bùhǎoyìsī.
transcript.en: Woman: We need to see the receipt before we can exchange items. Sorry.

transcript.zh: 女：這位小姐的意思是什麼？
transcript.py: Nǚ: Zhèwèi Xiǎojiě de yìsi shì shénme?
transcript.en: Woman: What does this young lady mean?
